title: Component in a Box
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: An exploded view of a cardboard box holding the six parts of the Chapter 18 quiz package, with a broken link outside the box and three finished boxes for Watershed Basics v1.1.

educational.topic: What goes into a packaged, reusable component
learningObjectives: The learner will list the files in a packaged component, say what each is for, and explain why a link that leaves the folder breaks the package.
prerequisites: Standalone components from [Chapter 9](../../chapters/09-modularity-metadata/index.md) and packaging from [Chapter 18](../../chapters/18-components-publishing-oer/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Does everything it needs travel with it?
Do all links stay inside the folder or use complete addresses?
commonMisconceptions: A link to a shared folder is fine
A license can be added later
assessmentOpportunities: Where must the script a page needs be kept?
Why does the box include a license file and a metadata file?
What should links inside a package be?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Numbered markers
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
